data.name: Aafreen
data.gender_notes: Aafreen is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Persian āfarīn (آفرین) 'praise, commendation, blessing', an exclamation of approval ('bravo!'). Borrowed into Urdu with the same sense and used as a female given name. Aafreen therefore means “Praise; commendation; 'bravo!'”. Persian noun/interjection āfarīn 'praise, bravo'; used as a female given name in Persian and Urdu.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aafreen expresses “Brave, Encouragement, Praise”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

faq.q: What does Aafreen mean in Persian?
faq.a: Aafreen is the Persian word āfarīn (آفرین), meaning 'praise, commendation' and used as an exclamation of approval - 'bravo!'. It is also used as a girl's name.

faq.q: What does the name Aafreen mean?
Where does the name Aafreen come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aafreen?
faq.a: The root of Aafreen is Persian āfarīn (آفرین).

faq.q: How is Aafreen written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aafreen is written آفرین in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aafreen a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aafreen is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aafreen appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aafreen is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aafreen verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Praise; commendation; 'bravo!'” is established by Persian noun/interjection āfarīn 'praise, bravo'; used as a female given name in Persian and Urdu..
